record.reason: Locas attaches locally supported parametric memory for continual learning and reports accuracy/parameter/time tradeoffs for test-time training. It can reduce memory parameters versus some adaptation baselines, but its reported relative times include added adaptation compute and do not show cheaper ordinary LLM serving.
record.title: Locas: Your Models are Principled Initializers of Locally-Supported Parametric Memories
